Author: Anomaly
Name: Eorzea Timers
Punchline: Create and track personalized timers in FFXIV.
Description: Create persistent, personalized countdown and repeating timers with configurable alerts, snooze controls, and an in-game overlay.
Changelog:
Stage 6 - Repeating Timers and Snooze
- Added interval, daily, weekly, selected-weekday, and monthly repeats.
- Added preset and custom snooze controls.
- Added per-timer overlay notes with right-click toggling.
- Added twelve selectable FFXIV chat sounds and sound previewing.
- Added manual restart and next-occurrence previews.
- Save and Cancel now remain visible while editing.
- Missed repeating timers advance quietly after login.
